title: Orders with customer names
task: Set result to orders merged with customers on customer_id, keeping order_id, first_name, last_name, total_amount.

title: Items with product names
task: Set result to order_items merged with products on product_id, keeping item_id, name, quantity, unit_price.

title: Customers who never ordered
task: Set result to a Series of first_name for customers with no orders.

title: Revenue per category
task: Set result to a Series: delivered-order revenue (quantity*unit_price) summed per product category, rounded to 2 decimals.
answer:
m = order_items.merge(orders[['order_id', 'status']], on='order_id').merge(products[['product_id', 'category']], on='product_id')
m = m[m['status'] == 'delivered']
result = (m['quantity'] * m['unit_price']).groupby(m['category']).sum().round(2)

title: Multiple aggregations
task: Set result to a DataFrame indexed by status with columns orders (count) and revenue (sum of total_amount, 2 dp).

title: Average order value per country
task: Set result to a Series of mean total_amount per customer country (2 dp), delivered orders only.

title: Top spender
task: Set result to the customer_id with the highest total delivered spend (as an int).

title: Units sold per product
task: Set result to a Series of quantity summed per product name, sorted descending.

title: Repeat customers
task: Set result to a Series of order counts per customer_id, keeping only customers with 3 or more orders.

title: Products never reviewed
context: Anti-join: products with no review rows.
task: Set result to a Series of product names with no rows in reviews.

title: Full name column
task: Set result to customers with a column full_name = first_name + ' ' + last_name.

title: Size bucket with a function
task: Set result to orders with a column bucket: 'large' if total_amount >= 300, 'medium' if >= 100, else 'small'.

title: Email domains
task: Set result to a Series of counts per email domain (text after '@'), for customers with an email.

title: Products containing 'Pro'
task: Set result to product names containing 'Pro' (case-sensitive) as a Series.

title: Orders per month
task: Set result to a Series of order counts per month, indexed by 'YYYY-MM' strings, sorted by month.

title: Days since signup
task: Set result to customers with a column days_active = days between signup_date and 2025-07-31 (as int).

title: Weekend orders share
task: Set result to the percentage of orders placed on Saturday or Sunday, rounded to 1 decimal.

title: Status by country pivot
task: Set result to pd.crosstab of customer country (rows) vs order status (columns) for all orders.
answer:
m = orders.merge(customers[['customer_id', 'country']], on='customer_id')
result = pd.crosstab(m['country'], m['status'])

title: Units by category and year
task: Set result to a pivot_table with index=category, columns=order year, values=quantity summed, fill_value=0.
answer:
m = order_items.merge(orders[['order_id', 'order_date']], on='order_id').merge(products[['product_id', 'category']], on='product_id')
m['year'] = m['order_date'].dt.year
result = m.pivot_table(index='category', columns='year', values='quantity', aggfunc='sum', fill_value=0)

title: Fill missing emails
task: Set result to customers with email missing values replaced by 'no-email'.

title: Rank products by price
task: Set result to products with a column price_rank = dense rank by price descending (as int).

title: Top 2 products per category by price
task: Set result to a DataFrame of the 2 most expensive products per category with columns category, name, price.

title: Average rating per product
task: Set result to a Series of mean rating per product name (2 dp), for products with reviews.

title: Products rated 4+ on average with 3+ reviews
task: Set result to a DataFrame indexed by product name with columns avg_rating (2 dp) and n, keeping avg_rating >= 4 and n >= 3.
answer:
g = reviews.merge(products, on='product_id').groupby('name')['rating'].agg(avg_rating='mean', n='count')
g['avg_rating'] = g['avg_rating'].round(2)
result = g[(g['avg_rating'] >= 4) & (g['n'] >= 3)]

title: Orders whose total doesn't match its items
task: Set result to a Series of order_id values where |total_amount − Σ quantity*unit_price| > 0.01.
hint: Group items, join, compare with abs.
answer:
s = (order_items['quantity'] * order_items['unit_price']).groupby(order_items['order_id']).sum().rename('item_sum')
m = orders.merge(s, left_on='order_id', right_index=True)
result = m.loc[(m['total_amount'] - m['item_sum']).abs() > 0.01, 'order_id']

title: Reviews without a purchase
task: Set result to the number of reviews where no order by that customer contains that product.
hint: Build a set of (customer_id, product_id) purchased pairs.
answer:
bought = orders.merge(order_items, on='order_id')[['customer_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates()
m = reviews.merge(bought, on=['customer_id', 'product_id'], how='left', indicator=True)
result = int((m['_merge'] == 'left_only').sum())

title: Group a list of tuples
task: Given pairs = [('a',1),('b',2),('a',3),('c',4),('b',5)], set result to a dict mapping key → list of values.
answer:
pairs = [('a',1),('b',2),('a',3),('c',4),('b',5)]
d = defaultdict(list)
for k, v in pairs:
    d[k].append(v)
result = dict(d)

title: Safe division
task: Define safe_div(a, b) returning a/b, or None when b is 0; set result to [safe_div(10, 4), safe_div(1, 0)].

title: Extract order numbers
task: Given text = 'Orders ORD-5001 and ORD-5017 shipped; ORD-5003 pending', set result to the list of integers after 'ORD-'.
answer:
text = 'Orders ORD-5001 and ORD-5017 shipped; ORD-5003 pending'
result = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'ORD-(\d+)', text)]

title: Sort by two keys
task: Given people = [('Ann', 30), ('Bob', 25), ('Cid', 30), ('Dee', 25)], set result to the list sorted by age ascending then name descending.
hint: sorted(people, key=lambda p: (p[1], ...)) — reverse the name by sorting twice or using a negative trick isn't possible for strings; sort by name desc first, then stable-sort by age.
answer:
people = [('Ann', 30), ('Bob', 25), ('Cid', 30), ('Dee', 25)]
result = sorted(sorted(people, key=lambda p: p[0], reverse=True), key=lambda p: p[1])

title: Nested to flat
task: Given nested = [[1, 2], [3], [4, 5, 6]], set result to the flat list [1,2,3,4,5,6].
hint: [x for sub in nested for x in sub].
answer:
nested = [[1, 2], [3], [4, 5, 6]]
result = [x for sub in nested for x in sub]

title: Median and stdev
task: Given nums = [4, 8, 15, 16, 23, 42], set result to (median, round(sample stdev, 3)).

title: Parse JSON
task: Given payload = '{"order": 5001, "items": [{"sku": 101, "qty": 2}, {"sku": 104, "qty": 1}]}', set result to the total qty across items.
answer:
payload = '{"order": 5001, "items": [{"sku": 101, "qty": 2}, {"sku": 104, "qty": 1}]}'
data = json.loads(payload)
result = sum(i['qty'] for i in data['items'])
